question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Alert
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Alert"** means being watchful and prompt to meet danger or emergency, or quick to perceive and act. (सतर्क)

 
 
• **Example:** The guards were **alert **and ready to respond to any threat.
 
 
 
• **"Vigilant"** refers to keeping careful watch for possible danger or difficulties. (सावधान)
 
 
• **Example:** The **vigilant **neighbor noticed the suspicious activity and called the police.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Alert'** is **'Vigilant'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dull** (मंद): Lacking interest or excitement; lacking brightness, vividness, or sheen.

 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was so dull that several students fell asleep.
 
 
 
• **Inactive** (निष्क्रिय): Not engaging in or involving any or much physical activity.
 
 
• **Example:** Due to his inactive lifestyle, he gained a lot of weight.
